about: Numbers behind docs/notes/phase-0-spikes.md, section Tasks and the Orchestrator. One run per entry of spikes/hub/delegation.py over the 20 lines of docs/notes/talker-delegation.txt; a turn's line is the line it answered, or for an event turn the line whose Task it relayed (the last line typed before it). Times in ms from the line or event reaching the Hub; p50 and p90 interpolate linearly between ranks. text_before_first_tool is null for a turn without tool calls.

prompts.A: Hard rule: text before the first tool call; one sentence, delegate, then end your turn.
prompts.B: A, plus the status example and 'end your turn with nothing more said'; delegate's result also carried a hint to end the turn.
prompts.C: B without the hint in delegate's result, and 'say nothing after it' for 'end your turn'.
prompts.D: C, plus delegate's description saying there is nothing to add after calling it. The committed prompts/talker.md and hub.py.

stub_question.broad: the stub asked which repo for any Task message mentioning an issue
stub_question.narrow: the stub asked which repo only for a request starting 'Open an issue' or 'Apri una issue'

end_to_end.about: `jarvis-hub --text` with the real Talker (sonnet, low) and the real Orchestrator (sonnet, medium) against the real Org, two lines piped at launch: 'What PRs are open in pumpkit?' and 'Is CI green on the main branch of jarvis?'. Rows in the order the Hub wrote them; Orchestrator times run from the delegate call to the end of its turn.
